programme.title: The Society Murders
programme.desc: A building inspector arrives at Wentworth to inspect the rebuilding, but he's a fake. Once inside the jail, he knocks Colleen out, ties her up, and plants bombs around the prison. Meg rescues Colleen, but the women have been locked in the laundry with a bomb inside ticking away... Sharon is charged with murder as Alpha Centauri's true nature is exposed in the press, shattering her illusions. Helen decides to implicate herself to help her sister. Lizzie gets wind of Petra and Scott's relationship but vows to keep quiet. Petra tells Lizzie her father abused her, and was going to do the same to her sister, Emma, which is why she killed him. Later, when Emma visits Petra, we learn it was actually Emma who killed him. Lucy attacks Major the dog to stop him finding her drugs, and a furious Joan turfs her out. Ann forgives Wally. Lizzie gets a telegram from Foxy.

programme.desc: DNA evidence and camera footage places a corrupt CEO as the prime suspect in the murder of a company whistle-blower, but Jane Doe believes the real killer may be a twin sibling.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: A Time to Remember
programme.desc: Poignant drama starring Dana Delany (ʻDesperate Housewivesʼ, ʻBody of Proofʼ) as a bohemian artist and single mother who returns to her childhood home for a Thanksgiving family reunion. She is hoping to reconcile with her prim and proper mother (Doris Roberts, ʻMrs Miracleʼ) with whom she has always clashed, but it gradually dawns on her that her mother is in the early stages of Alzheimerʼs disease, and the whole family has to face up to reality.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same 'street' family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: " Devil Boy ", once foundling in the port of Shanghai , has become a avaontuurlijke young thief . He steals every street as he considers his family to be able to provide food . Now he has with his faithful companion Bird devised a cunning plan to steal the jewels of the royal palace . For this he needs to hand things from Li Wei, the daughter of the governor, where he immediately falls in love with . Coincidentally, Li Wei is just looking for a suitable marriage partner . But there is a lot of competition from the Prince from the North, which appear to be politically given the right choice for the governor. Li Wei, however, is charmed by Devil Boy and persuades her father to subdue her suitors to a series of difficult tests.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.desc: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes - the world's greatest detective - faces a most alluring adversary... Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. programme.title: Merlin's Apprentice
programme.desc: Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

programme.desc: This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

programme.desc: Meteor is a disaster mini-series about a meteor on a collision course with Earth. After NASA discovers a giant meteor named Kassandra that threatens to erase humanity of the planet, astronomer Dr. Lehman and his assistant Imogene O'Neil must hurry to collect information about it. Lehman tragically dies along the way. Meanwhile, meteor showers are occurring worldwide causing panic. One of the towns hit by the meteorites is Taft in California. There, detective Jack Crowe is tries to find his ex partner Stark before he kills his daughter and father who is the sheriff of the town.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: Mystery drama featuring John Larroquette as a hard-nosed cop turned compassionate defence lawyer, who specialises in lost causes. His latest client is a failed actress who became a call girl out of desperation and is now accused of the brutal murder of a prominent Beverly Hills madam. McBride's investigations reveal that the victim was a blackmailer as well as a procurer, which considerably lengthens his list of suspects.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Picking Up And Dropping Off
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Scott Wolf and Amanda Detmer. Two thirty-ish New Yorkers keep bumping into each other but lack the courage to become better acquainted.

programme.title: Straight from the Heart
programme.desc: A photographer in NYC has her refuse photos trashed. Later her boyfriend of 5 years offers his apartment key, not an engagement ring. Fixed by her matchmaker roomie, she meets a single rancher in Wyoming.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the spectacular tradition of the Sonar Entertainment classics Merlin & Arabian Nights comes a magically splendid adventure for everyone. Devil Boy (John Reardon, Merlin's Apprentice), abandoned at birth and rescued from the docks of Shanghai to grow into an adventurous young thief, steals to provide food for the street children he considers his family. Now the clever lad and his faithful companion Bird (Golden Globe nominee David Carradine, Kill Bill) have their eyes on swindling the royal court of its jewels. The best way to do it is by winning the hand of the Governor's daughter, Princess Li Wei (Desiree Siahaan, Marco Polo) with whom he is immediately & genuinely smitten. As luck would have it, she's being presented with potential suitors. There is formidable competition with the Prince of the North (Rupert Graves) who is the choice for the Governor. The Princess, secretly attracted to D.B., manages to convince her father to arrange challenges for all her suitors. The Princess sends along her companion, an accomplished sword master, Ting Ting (Theresa Lee, Stargate SG-1), disguised as a man to keep D.B. safe. What the Princess does not know is that Ting Ting comes from the same 'street' family as D.B., & that she is in love with him. Framed for attempting to poison the Princess, D.B. and Bird are condemned to death. In the last moment, a guilt-ridden Ting Ting helps D.B. break free from the dungeon, safeguard the royal family, and claim Li Wei's hand in marriage as his own. But it takes the faith of Bird, a magical flying carpet, and the mystical Fruit of Life for D.B. and Li Wei to see their dream to the end. Sonar Entertainment invites you on a wild ride like no other--filled with dazzling romance, stirring action, and breathtaking suspense.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: " Devil Boy ", once foundling in the port of Shanghai , has become a avaontuurlijke young thief . He steals every street as he considers his family to be able to provide food . Now he has with his faithful companion Bird devised a cunning plan to steal the jewels of the royal palace . For this he needs to hand things from Li Wei, the daughter of the governor, where he immediately falls in love with . Coincidentally, Li Wei is just looking for a suitable marriage partner . But there is a lot of competition from the Prince from the North, which appear to be politically given the right choice for the governor. Li Wei, however, is charmed by Devil Boy and persuades her father to subdue her suitors to a series of difficult tests.

Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter pushes wildlife to the extreme. For some, it is a chance to thrive; for others, the only way to escape the icy hold of winter is to shut down every physical system. When spring finally comes, it is a time for celebration for those who managed to survive the most brutal of seasons.

programme.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients
programme.desc: Australias Land of the Ancients explores the unique and ancient landscape of northeastern Australia, the most biodiverse region on the continent. From Crocodiles lying in wait for fish and hunting feral pigs to caring marsupial mothers of the far north, the film highlights some of the incredible species as they struggle to survive in their harsh environment amid a changing landscape.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how wolf packs hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the way they work together to locate, isolate and bring down large bison and musk oxen. An arctic wolf pack must make a kill before the harsh winter arrives, while further south, grey wolves take on prey 10 times their size.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack... And Why
programme.desc: On Indonesias island of Bali, remote Balian Beach boasts black sand and idyllic sunsets. In 2010, the peace enjoyed by visitors and residents alike was suddenly shattered by a shocking shark attack the first ever recorded along its coast. After six more attacks occur at the same beach, experts investigate what has changed at Balian. What makes this small stretch of black sand the most dangerous beach in all of Bali?

programme.title: When Sharks Attack... And Why
programme.desc: A frightening yearly phenomenon plagues the waters of Hawaii - every October, shark attacks here more than double. Residents and tourists alike are baffled by the annual uptick, which threatens the peaceful reputation of this tropical paradise. Investigators are on the case, exploring the islands volcanic geography, exotic marine life, and human influence. Whats behind the mysterious occurrence, dubbed Sharktober?

programme.title: War of the Lions
programme.desc: From savannahs bursting with game to deserts with not a drop to drink, all lion kingdoms are not created equal… so who is the REAL King of the Beasts?

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: In the heart of India, a tiger family battles for dominance in the ruins of a lost empire. B1, a young tiger, challenges his aging grandfather for supremacy over their pride land, taking advantage of his slowed reflexes and struggling vision. Meanwhile, B1's mother tries to keep the peace for her new cubs during their risky first years of life, and for her father, who is becoming increasingly helpless. But B1 is bent on taking over and starting his own dynasty deep in the heart of ancient India.

programme.title: Eternal Enemies: Lions And Hyenas (Revealed)
programme.desc: The Joubert's Emmy winning film is back with stunning remastered footage. Propelled by Jeremy Irons gripping narration, Eternal Enemies reveals the story of conflict between lions and hyenas, relatively unknown or even suspected in the scientific world before this. The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: The World's Most Famous Tiger
programme.desc: Known as the Queen of Ranthambore, Machli is the most famous tiger in the world. The legendary tigress is a fearsome warrior known for her daring exploits. And she's the mother of an incredible four litters of cubs.

programme.title: Big Cat Week
programme.desc: RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER records the battle for survival of the big cats and reveals intimate details of their lives. The animals they prey on are also in the film: tigers couldn't survive without sika deer, Altai wapiti, wild boars and Asian black bears. A young tiger, born in a conservation area, will guide the viewer through the film. RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER accompanies him throughout the year after he leaves his mother. His search for a territory reveals the problems facing tigers in Russia's Far East, and the conflicts that arise when he strays into human settlements. The young tiger takes the viewer to places where the fate of Siberian tigers will be decided: vast forests, remote villages and the cities at the edge of the wilderness.

The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Super Pride
programme.desc: The Serengeti, in northern Tanzania, teems with big predators. But none compare to the lion. The Serengeti sustains one of the biggest lion populations in Africa: approximately 3,500 lions in 300 prides. But this pride, residing in the central Serengeti, is an exception. 22 lions in all: they are a Super Pride.

programme.title: Tree Climbing Lions
programme.desc: Big cat biologist Alexander Braczkowski is on a mission. He's got 90 days to count lions in Uganda and learn how the population is doing. But these aren't ordinary lions. The prides in Queen Elizabeth National Park spend most of their lives up in the trees, a rare and mysterious behavior unique to this part of Africa.

The intense relationship and enduring rivalry between the two species play out in a battle of survival. Narrated by Jeremy Irons.

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: In the heart of India, a tiger family battles for dominance in the ruins of a lost empire. B1, a young tiger, challenges his aging grandfather for supremacy over their pride land, taking advantage of his slowed reflexes and struggling vision. Meanwhile, B1's mother tries to keep the peace for her new cubs during their risky first years of life, and for her father, who is becoming increasingly helpless. But B1 is bent on taking over and starting his own dynasty deep in the heart of ancient India.

programme.title: The World's Most Famous Tiger
programme.desc: Known as the Queen of Ranthambore, Machli is the most famous tiger in the world. The legendary tigress is a fearsome warrior known for her daring exploits. And she's the mother of an incredible four litters of cubs.

programme.title: Big Cat Week
programme.desc: RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER records the battle for survival of the big cats and reveals intimate details of their lives. The animals they prey on are also in the film: tigers couldn't survive without sika deer, Altai wapiti, wild boars and Asian black bears. A young tiger, born in a conservation area, will guide the viewer through the film. RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER accompanies him throughout the year after he leaves his mother. His search for a territory reveals the problems facing tigers in Russia's Far East, and the conflicts that arise when he strays into human settlements. The young tiger takes the viewer to places where the fate of Siberian tigers will be decided: vast forests, remote villages and the cities at the edge of the wilderness.

programme.title: War of the Lions
programme.desc: From savannahs bursting with game to deserts with not a drop to drink, all lion kingdoms are not created equal… so who is the REAL King of the Beasts?

programme.title: When Sharks Attack... And Why
programme.desc: The South Pacific island of New Caledonia is a tropical paradise where sharks and humans usually coexist, peacefully. But in 2016, all of that changes. Sharks attack five beachgoers, resulting in two fatalities. Experts from across the globe join forces to investigate a variety of possible causes, including the islands unique marine landscape, the rise in aquatic watersports, and even a lone shark, gone rogue.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack... And Why
programme.desc: Charleston, South Carolina is renowned for its hospitality; but beginning in 2013, its resident sharks - werent quite as welcoming. Over two summers, five beachgoers are bitten within a 22-mile stretch of coastline. Scientists are on a mission to discover the reason behind the mysterious spike, examining the impact of beach rejuvenation, local reptile behavior, drought, and even a new shark species.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard's hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Iberia's Woodlands: Life on the Edge
programme.desc: Rivalry defines all life in the forests of the Iberian Peninsula. The arrival of summer marks the beginning of what will be a prolonged period of drought in the region, making survival even more difficult for the animals who call this place home. Every creature must fight for limited resources - making competition both within and between species unavoidable.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its powerful rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed. They share the rivers with other creatures of their kind, such as porcupines, the giant rodents in Africa; the martial eagle, the biggest of its kind on the continent; and the leopard, a giant among the spotted cats.

programme.title: Frozen Islands
programme.desc: It may be inhabitable for humans, but the icy ocean and frozen islands of the sub-antarctic region are home to millions of marine animals that have adapted to this testing environment. In this two-part series from National Geographic, the constant struggle for a wide variety of species is revealed, as they battle the elements and other dangers in a bid for survival. From penguins to seals, and albatrosses to whales, we showcase how these unique species live, breed and feed in the biting waters, which are also prowled by some of the most dangerous, underwater predators on our planet.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Killer Safari

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Dr Oakley: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Time is of the essence as Dr. Oakley races to diagnose a cat with an extreme bladder issue. But this mystery problem might have her calling for backup. A farm well equipped for handling cattle needs some help from Dr. Oakley to test out a new system for some rowdy bison. The dog days are back as Dr. Oakley hosts a drive thru vaccination clinic. Dr. Oakley checks on two ferrets as well as two German Shepherds with ailments common to their breeds.

programme.title: Dr Oakley: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Two bear cubs recovering from a harrowing experience need Dr. Oakley's expertise as they embark on a long journey to a new home. A cat's extreme mouth ulcers cause worry for its owner, but Dr. Oakley knows just what to do. What should be an easy surgery may just leave Rusty the Labrador Retriever breathless. Two baby goats are in need of castrations and Dr. Oakley and her daughters go swimming with horses.

programme.title: Secrets of the King Cobra
programme.desc: COBRA is an unprecedented journey into the natural history of the wild King Cobra-following them into their world-revealing what they do, where they go, and who they interact with-when we are not around. And surprisingly, the people of India are very much a part of the story. Early evidence suggests that kings might be more intertwined with humans than previously thought., making this project more important than ever.1 It's a close and personal look into the secret life of the King-and the best chance we have of ensuring the survival of this legendary snake.

programme.title: Ultimate Rivals: Cats vs Dogs
programme.desc: Canines and felines have been living side by side in Africa for hundreds of thousands of years, and they've never really gotten along-not even amongst themselves. Throw the hyena into the mix and they're all nightmare neighbors? Stealing from each other; harassing each other; eating each other's young. Avoidance might be the only way to stay alive. Cats, dogs and the wild-card hyena, all jousting in a free for all for survival.

programme.title: Venom Files - Anatomy of a Snake Bite
programme.desc: Millions are bitten by snakes each year, yet their venom evolved for hunting, not harming humans. Explore the fascinating and deadly adaptations of the king cobra, black mamba, inland taipan, puff adder, saw-scaled viper, Mozambique spitting cobra and the fearsome boomslang. Journey from India's vibrant villages to Africa's wild bush and Australia's outback to witness how venom paralyzes, digests and protects. Discover why every snakebite is different — and how our worlds collide in surprising ways. Each snake's venom tells a story, engineered to hunt, defend and survive. But as humans and snakes collide, the chemistry that once kept balance now brings catastrophe. "Venom Files" reveals nature's deadliest assassins.

programme.title: Blood Rivals: Lion vs Buffalo
programme.desc: In Africa, no other herbivore rivals the buffalo with its brute force and collective strategy; honed over millennia in an evolutionary blood feud with the ultimate predator. For most of the year the breeding herd fends off relentless attacks from the resident lion pride. Then, when the dry season sucks water away from the grasslands, they migrate beyond the reach of the killers, but risk starvation. Life is a perpetual Catch 22 for the buffaloes where payment for fresh water and sweet grasses is made in blood.

programme.title: Predator v Prey
programme.desc: A forensic look at how polar bears hunt prey, offering new perspectives on the tactics they use to track, stalk and ambush seals, whales and walruses. We follow a mother fighting to feed her two cubs in the harsh polar extremes, and a young male driven by starvation to tackle enormous prey.

programme.title: Snakes In the City Compilations
programme.desc: Simon and Sioux are amazed by the respect Indian locals have for their venomous scaled neighbors. The calls are pouring in, and Snake Shyam helps rescue a deadly Russell's viper tangled in netting. Shyam's son, Surya, is breaking concrete steps to help Simon and Sioux finally capture a rat snake. Then, the duo teams with Gowri Shanker to catch and release not one but two enormous king cobras.

programme.title: Snakes In the City Compilations
programme.desc: A dangerous heatwave surges across India, which means more deadly snakes are on the move looking for shelter. Simon and Sioux join Snake Shyam and Gowri Shanker to battle the heat and rescue hiding snakes. The team tries to rescue a spectacled cobra from a water pit and a deadly Russell's viper hiding in a bookstore. For the first time in 30 years, Simon tails and rescues a king cobra by himself!

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The Critter Fixer docs care for snakes of all sizes with a variety of medical mysteries. A hognose snake battles a dangerous respiratory infection, staff face their fears to treat venomous rescue snakes, and a boa constrictor struggles to get moving. A pint-sized serpent wins over clinic staff, a red-tailed boa presents a mysterious lump, and a Western hognose snake faces an emergency c-section.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Ledo kelias

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: It is pure luck to have a genie to fulfill all wishes, to have two of them is something incredible. Leah is a little girl with a genie bottle necklace, which includes Shimmer and Shine, genie twins. Shimmer is a genie with blue eyes and pink hair, encouraging and passionate, she has a pet, a gibbon monkey Tala. Shine is her twin genie with purple eyes and blue hair, big animal lover. Her pet is a little Bengal tiger Nahal. Zac is Leah's neighbor with red hair and blue eyes, and her best human friend. Leah is making three wishes every day, genies are doing their best but the results are far from perfect, as genies are very young and unskilled. This is the source of awkward and comic situations, but in the end girls manage to get over all difficulties.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.desc: Rusty Rivets is a fantastic and picturesque animated series about Rusty who lives in Sparkton Hills along with his friend Ruby Ramirez, a robotic tyrannosaurid named Botasaur, and a group of smaller robots known as the Bits. Rusty is a smart inventor and a little genius who with the help of his amazing discoveries helps his friends out of difficulties. Rusty constructs robots of different sizes, forms and purposes, he is in love with science, technology and engineering. Together with his friend Ruby they can repair any old machinery and out-of-date equipment. Their splendid intellect arouses envy and toxic rivals do not play the game clean.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

Something sinister bubbles under the surface the happy animals are actually androids, and the real animals are held captive in a dungeon. They're too messy and Zookeeper Frances can't stand a mess! programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Gigi Proietti, Vincenzo Salemme ed Enrico Brignano. Un poliziotto addetto alle intercettazioni spia la vita degli altri scoprendone segreti e imbrogli.

programme.title: Johnny Stecchino
programme.desc: Capolavoro di comicita' diretto e interpretato dal premio Oscar Roberto Benigni. Nel duplice ruolo di un boss latitante e del suo sosia, l'attore toscano si trova coinvolto in una girandola di spassosi equivoci quando si innamora della moglie di un pentito che la mafia ha condannato a morte. La donna, infatti, vuole far credere che l'ingenuo giovanotto sia il marito per farlo eliminare! Sfuggito casualmente ai numerosi agguati, tra esilaranti furti di banane passati alla storia del cinema, il nostro autista forse riuscira' a salvare la pelle...

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Mentre Finn, ora diciassettenne, fatica a rimettere in sesto la sua vita, la sorella Gwen inizia a ricevere chiamate nei suoi sogni e ad avere inquietanti visioni di tre ragazzi perseguitati in un luogo noto come Alpine Lake.

programme.title: E poi si vede
programme.desc: Tre ragazzi competono per un posto di lavoro nell'ufficio legale del municipio. Federico conta sull'aiuto di suo padre, consigliere comunale, Fabrizio cerca un'altra opportunità e Luca, ragazzo privilegiato, si unisce alla corsa.

programme.title: La lezione
programme.desc: Un'avvocatessa triestina in crisi scagiona un professore universitario dall'accusa di molestie sessuali, pur rifiutando di assisterlo ulteriormente. Un incubo però si riaffaccia nella vita della legale: il suo stalker è tornato in libertà.

programme.title: Una notte a New York
programme.desc: Dakota Johnson e Sean Penn instaurano una connessione profonda in un film di rivelazioni e complicità, opera prima di Christy Hall. La conversazione fra una donna e un tassista nel tragitto dall'aeroporto JFK e Manhattan diventa un lungo dialogo sulle loro emozioni più intime.

programme.title: Official Secrets - Segreto di stato
programme.desc: Thriller biografico con Keira Knightley e Ralph Fiennes. Nel 2003, la traduttrice inglese Katharine Gun denuncia un complotto politico atto a favorire l'intervento militare in Iraq.

programme.desc: Black Bag - Doppio Gioco.

programme.title: Robin Hood - L'origine della leggenda
programme.desc: Tornato in Inghilterra, Robin di Loxley scopre che il malvagio sceriffo di Nottingham ha preso possesso delle sue proprietà. L'uomo si unisce a una banda di ribelli, in un piano audace per rubare allo sceriffo i suoi soldi e togliergli il potere.

programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola senza tempo con Patrick Swayze, Demi Moore e Whoopi Goldberg. Con l'aiuto di una medium, il fantasma di un uomo assassinato cerca di proteggere la fidanzata.

programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel secondo capitolo della nuova trilogia. Owen e Claire scoprono una cospirazione mentre tentano di salvare i dinosauri da un'eruzione.

programme.title: Buona giornata
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Diego Abatantuono, Christian De Sica e Lino Banfi. L'Italia di oggi in sette episodi su politici corrotti, escort, quiz televisivi e tifosi di calcio.

programme.title: Jurassic World – Il regno distrutto
programme.desc: Chris Pratt e Bryce Dallas Howard nel secondo capitolo della nuova trilogia. Owen e Claire scoprono una cospirazione mentre tentano di salvare i dinosauri da un'eruzione.

programme.title: Il maestro
programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: November - I cinque giorni dopo il Bataclan
programme.desc: Jean Dujardin nella pellicola che ricostruisce le indagini sugli attentati del 2015. Fred, un poliziotto dell'antiterrorismo, deve trovare i fuggitivi più ricercati di Francia.

programme.title: La stranezza
programme.desc: 4 David di Donatello al film di Roberto Andò con Toni Servillo affiancato dal duo comico Ficarra e Picone. Sicilia, 1920: l'incontro con due scapestrati becchini con la vocazione per il teatro ispira a Luigi Pirandello la stesura di "Sei personaggi in cerca d'autore".

programme.title: September 5 - La diretta che cambiò la storia
programme.desc: Il ritmo serrato del thriller per ripercorrere uno storico evento mediatico. 1972: durante le Olimpiadi di Monaco di Baviera, un commando palestinese uccide due atleti israeliani e ne prende in ostaggio nove. Una troupe della ABC documenta i drammatici eventi in tempo reale.

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: Lee Miller
programme.desc: Racconto intenso sulla vita della fotografa Lee Miller, che esplora il costo emotivo del suo lavoro e il coraggio necessario per documentare la realtà brutale della guerra.

programme.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Tahar Rahim (Il profeta) è Charles Aznavour. Dalla difficile infanzia nella Parigi popolare all’incontro con Édith Piaf, il viaggio umano e artistico di un’icona senza tempo.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: Sentimental Value
programme.desc: Nora e Agnes, due sorelle molto unite, si ritrovano a dover affrontare il ritorno del padre, regista carismatico ma assente nelle loro vite. L'uomo desidera realizzare il suo ultimo film e includere una delle figlie nel progetto.

programme.title: Ammazzare stanca
programme.desc: La storia vera di Antonio Zagari, figlio di un boss della 'ndrangheta calabrese trapiantata in Lombardia. Nei primi anni '70 Antonio sviluppa un'avversione fisica per la violenza e decide di ribellarsi alla tradizione criminale di famiglia.

programme.title: I guerrieri della notte
programme.desc: Capolavoro di Walter Hill e un classico dell'action. New York: accusati di omicidio, i Warriors devono sfuggire alla ritorsione delle bande rivali nel corso di una lunga notte di agguati.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Anna Karenina
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Jude Law nell'adattamento del capolavoro di Lev Tolstoj. 1874: la moglie di un funzionario della Russia zarista si innamora di un giovane ufficiale. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista sudcoreano, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Le buone stelle - Broker
programme.desc: Kore-eda dirige Song Kang-ho (Parasite), premiato a Cannes. Due benevoli contrabbandieri di bambini intercettano un bebe' abbandonato in una 'baby box', ma la polizia e' sulle loro tracce.

programme.title: C'e' Ancora Domani
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Paola Cortellesi, anche protagonista, entrato nella storia del cinema italiano. Roma,1946: Delia ha accettato la sua vita ma spera in un futuro migliore per la figlia.

programme.title: Sentimental Value
programme.desc: Nora e Agnes, due sorelle molto unite, si ritrovano a dover affrontare il ritorno del padre, regista carismatico ma assente nelle loro vite. L'uomo desidera realizzare il suo ultimo film e includere una delle figlie nel progetto.

programme.title: Il cavaliere elettrico
programme.desc: Cult anni 70 di Sydney Pollack con Robert Redford e Jane Fonda. Un campione di rodeo ruba un cavallo e fugge verso le montagne, inseguito da una giornalista in cerca di scoop.

programme.title: 12 anni schiavo
programme.desc: Steve McQueen dirige Chiwetel Ejiofor e Michael Fassbender in un biopic premiato con 3 Oscar. Nella Louisiana dell'800, un violinista afroamericano viene rapito e ridotto in schiavitù.

programme.title: Il piacere è tutto mio
programme.desc: Commedia romantica sulla 'sex positivity' con Emma Thompson e Daryl McCormack. Nancy, vedova matura e insoddisfatta, ingaggia un giovane gigolo' per vivere la sua prima esperienza appagante.

programme.title: Anna Karenina
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Jude Law nell'adattamento del capolavoro di Lev Tolstoj. 1874: la moglie di un funzionario della Russia zarista si innamora di un giovane ufficiale. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.desc: Rhaenyra cerca Aemond e Vhagar; Daemon tenta di contenere il caos ad Approdo del Re con le Cappe Dorate. Aemond, Aegon e Cole affrontano sfide e limiti personali.

programme.title: Lady Vendetta
programme.desc: Ingiustamente incarcerata per l'omicidio di un bambino, una donna fa della vendetta verso i veri colpevoli la sua ragione di vita.

programme.title: La Vita È Bella
programme.desc: Guido e la famiglia vivono il peso delle Leggi Razziali. Ebreo, viene deportato in campo di concentramento con il figlioletto Giosuè. L'uomo costruisce quindi un elaborato mondo di fantasie per proteggere il piccolo dagli orrori della guerra.

programme.title: The Happy Prince
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia per Rupert Everett nei panni di Oscar Wilde. A Parigi si consumano gli ultimi giorni dello scrittore, rinnegato da chi lo aveva idolatrato. Nel cast Colin Firth.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista sudcoreano, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: Thomas Vinterberg ricostruisce la storia vera del sottomarino russo affondato nel mare di Barents nell'estate del 2000. Con Léa Seydoux, Colin Firth, Matthias Schoenaerts e Max von Sydow.

programme.title: Le vele scarlatte
programme.desc: Pietro Marcello dirige Juliette Jouan e Louis Garrel dal romanzo di Aleksandr Grin. Normandia, primo dopoguerra: malvista da tutti nel villaggio una giovane sognatrice incontra l'amore.

programme.title: Gioia mia
programme.desc: Gioia, un'insegnante di letteratura francese, instaura un legame proibito, fragile e inspiegabilmente necessario con Alessio, un suo studente. Quest'ultimo però distrugge tutto e cancella l'unica persona che lo abbia mai amato.

programme.title: Lettere da Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe alla pellicola di Clint Eastwood che, dopo "Flags of Our Fathers", torna ad affrontare la battaglia di Iwo Jima ma questa volta dal punto di vista giapponese.

programme.title: Anna Karenina
programme.desc: Keira Knightley e Jude Law nell'adattamento del capolavoro di Lev Tolstoj. 1874: la moglie di un funzionario della Russia zarista si innamora di un giovane ufficiale. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: La battaglia di Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al War movie di Mel Gibson con Andrew Garfield, da una storia vera. Seconda guerra mondiale: un soldato ottiene la medaglia al valore malgrado il rifiuto di impugnare le armi.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: Thomas Vinterberg ricostruisce la storia vera del sottomarino russo affondato nel mare di Barents nell'estate del 2000. Con Léa Seydoux, Colin Firth, Matthias Schoenaerts e Max von Sydow.

programme.title: Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood, Amy Adams e Justin Timberlake in un film su padri e figli. Un anziano talent-scout del baseball ricuce il rapporto con la figlia mentre cerca un nuovo campione da lanciare.

programme.title: Il capo perfetto
programme.desc: Javier Bardem in una dark comedy sul mondo del lavoro premiatissima in Spagna. Il padrone di un'azienda e' disposto a tutto pur di vincere un importante premio.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: Intervista a Matilda De Angelis
programme.desc: Matilda De Angelis, protagonista del film "La lezione" con Stefano Accorsi, ci racconta aneddoti e curiosità sul set del thriller diretto da Stefano Mordini.

programme.title: Piccole donne
programme.desc: Rilettura di un classico diretto da Greta Gerwig con Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Laura Dern e Meryl Streep. La storia delle sorelle March nell'America della Guerra Civile. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: Dream Horse
programme.desc: Toni Collette e Damian Lewis in un’emozionante storia vera. Galles: una cassiera convince i suoi concittadini a investire su un purosangue per partecipare a un prestigioso concorso ippico.

programme.title: Eden
programme.desc: Diretto da Ron Howard, un avvincente thriller basato su una storia vera con Jude Law e Vanessa Kirby. Dopo la crisi del 1929, il dottore e filosofo Friedrich Ritter decide di lasciare la Germania e di trasferirsi in un'isola remota delle Galapagos.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: Thomas Vinterberg ricostruisce la storia vera del sottomarino russo affondato nel mare di Barents nell'estate del 2000. Con Léa Seydoux, Colin Firth, Matthias Schoenaerts e Max von Sydow.

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Il quadro rubato
programme.desc: André Masson, esperto di arte moderna, riceve una lettera in cui si dice che un dipinto di Egon Schiele è stato trovato a Mulhouse. Dell'opera era scomparsa ogni traccia ormai dal 1939.

programme.title: C'era una volta a... Hollywood
programme.desc: Oscar a Brad Pitt nel film di Quentin Tarantino con Leonardo DiCaprio e Margot Robbie. 1969: le vicende di Sharon Tate si intrecciano con quelle di un attore in declino e del suo stuntman.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Due uomini ossessionati dalle teorie complottistiche rapiscono l'amministratrice delegata di una grande azienda, convinti che sia un'aliena che vuole distruggere la Terra.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata
programme.desc: Jack O' Connell e Laura Dern nel biopic che ritorna su un controverso caso giuridico. Texas, 7 febbraio 2004: dopo dodici anni nel braccio della morte, Cameron Todd Willingham viene giustiziato per aver appiccato volontariamente l’incendio che ha provocato la morte delle tre figlie. Una sentenza arrivata al termine di un processo pieno di contraddizioni e punti oscuri. Diretto dal produttore di “Shakespeare in Love”, Edward Zwick. Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.title: Crimes of the Future
programme.desc: Sci-fi di David Cronenberg con Viggo Mortensen e Lea Seydoux. Un performer capace di sviluppare nuovi organi interni esibisce le sue mutazioni in spettacoli d'avanguardia.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulla serie dei film Transformers.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf e Megan Fox nel primo capitolo della saga sci-fi prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Due razze aliene, gli Autobots e i Decepticons, scelgono la Terra come campo di battaglia.

programme.title: Transformers - La vendetta del caduto
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della spettacolare saga con Megan Fox, Shia LaBeouf e i celebri robot. I Decepticon sfidano gli Autobot e gli umani nel tentativo di risvegliare il loro capo assoluto.

programme.title: Transformers 3
programme.desc: Michael Bay dirige Shia LaBeouf e John Turturro nel terzo capitolo della saga prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Gli Autobot devono difendersi dai Decepticons e da un nuovo terribile nemico.

programme.title: Transformers 4 - L'era dell'estinzione
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg nel quarto capitolo della saga dedicata ai personaggi della Hasbro. Alcuni anni dopo la distruzione di Chicago, un inventore ritrova Optimus Prime, il leader degli Autobot.

programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg e Anthony Hopkins nel quinto capitolo della saga diretta da Michael Bay. Un'inaspettata alleanza e' l'unica possibilita' per salvare la Terra da una minaccia spaziale.

programme.desc: Il reboot di animazione targato Warner che celebra i 50 anni degli amati personaggi di Hanna-Barbera. La nascita dell’amicizia fra Scooby-Doo e Shaggy si intreccia con un nuovo caso da risolvere per la Mystery Inc., alle prese con il malvagio Dick Dastardly, che vuole liberare il cane infernale Cerbero.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Settembre
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello all'opera prima di Giulia Steigerwalt con Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Barbara Ronchi. Al ritorno dalle vacanze si snodano i destini di tre personaggi pronti a cambiare vita.

programme.title: La quattordicesima domenica del tempo ordinario
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Lodo Guenzi, Edwige Fenech e Gabriele Lavia in una storia sul tempo perduto. L'incontro fra due ex amanti riporta alla luce sogni e disillusioni.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Amanda Sthers dirige Pierfrancesco Favino, Kelly Reilly e Jean Reno in una storia d’amore che rincorre il tempo, tratta da un suo romanzo. La vita di un uomo, padre di famiglia dal passato difficile, viene travolta dall’incontro con una donna in procinto di sposarsi.

programme.title: Romantiche

programme.title: Ti va di ballare?
programme.desc: Antonio Banderas a passo di danza in una pellicola tratta da una storia vera. Un ballerino professionista accetta di insegnare in una scuola frequentata da ragazzi disadattati.

programme.title: Family McMullen, The
programme.desc: Mentre affrontano ostacoli inaspettati, i legami di una famiglia vengono messi alla prova, rivelando la complessità dell'amore e della crescita all'interno di una famiglia.

programme.title: Intervista Jasmine Trinca-Andrea De Sica
programme.desc: Jasmine Trinca e Andrea De Sica, rispettivamente protagonista e regista del film "Gli occhi degli altri", raccontano aneddoti e curiosità dal set.

programme.title: Appuntamento con l'amore
programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.desc: 7 Oscar e Orso d'argento a Berlino a un'epica love story con Gwyneth Paltrow e un grande cast. Londra, 1593. In crisi creativa, Shakespeare trova l'ispirazione grazie all'amore per Viola.

programme.title: Duplicity
programme.desc: Clive Owen e Julia Roberts in una commedia intessuta di doppio gioco. Due spie industriali, ex agenti segreti ed ex amanti, uniscono i loro intenti per impadronirsi di una formula segreta.

programme.title: Secret Love
programme.desc: Dramma romantico con Josh O'Connor, Odessa Young, Olivia Colman e Colin Firth. Inghilterra, 1924: una cameriera incontra di nascosto il suo amante, che sta per sposare un'altra donna.

programme.desc: Marilyn Lima e Nicolas Duvauchelle in una magica avventura su un amore impossibile. Un cantante si prende cura di una sirena ferita, ma cade vittima della sua voce ammaliante.

programme.title: Innamorarsi
programme.desc: Un'intensa storia romantica con la straordinaria coppia da Oscar, Robert De Niro-Meryl Streep. Lui ingegnere, lei disegnatrice pubblicitaria, si incontrano casualmente in una libreria di New York, alla vigilia di Natale. Si rivedono poi ogni giorno, sul treno per andare a lavoro. Entrambi sposati, si innamorano sia pure tra mille riserve che alla fine prendono il sopravvento. Tra loro cala il silenzio, ma il destino li fara' incontrare ancora un anno piu' tardi... David di Donatello alla Streep come miglior attrice straniera.

programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.desc: George Clooney dirige e interpreta una commedia brillante con Renee Zellweger e John Krasinski. 1925: un capitano di football e un giovane fuoriclasse si innamorano della stessa donna.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.desc: Commedia natalizia Sky Original con Freida Pinto e Iwan Rheon. In cerca di un successo natalizio per la sua boy band, una manager trova un brano perfetto, scritto da un musicista metal.

programme.title: Beata te
programme.desc: Serena Rossi e Fabio Balsamo nella commedia Sky Original di Paola Randi. Marta riceve la visita dell'Arcangelo che le annuncia l'arrivo di un figlio. Basteranno 14 giorni per decidere?

programme.title: The Colour Room
programme.desc: Phoebe Dynevor nel biopic targato Sky Original, diretto da Claire McCarthy. La storia della rivoluzionaria artista della ceramica Clarice Cliff, una delle prime esponenti dell'Art Deco.

programme.desc: Peter Cattaneo ("Full Monty") dirige un biopic al femminile con Kristin Scott Thomas. Per sopportare l'assenza dei mariti in missione in Afghanistan, alcune donne formano un coro musicale.

programme.desc: Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves in una love story che trascende lo spazio e il tempo. Arrivato nella sua nuova casa sul lago, Alex trova una lettera della precedente inquilina, Kate, con cui inizia un rapporto epistolare. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

programme.title: Les Mise'rables
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 3 Golden Globe al dramma musicale con Hugh Jackman, Anne Hathaway e Russell Crowe, dal romanzo di Victor Hugo. Un ex detenuto si riscostruisce una nuova vita sotto falso nome.

programme.desc: Esilarante commedia di Max Bruno con Paola Cortellesi, Raoul Bova, Rocco Papaleo e Anna Foglietta. Dopo la morte del marito, una donna decide di diventare una escort per pagare i debiti (ITA 2011).

programme.desc: Matilda De Angelis, protagonista del film "La lezione" con Stefano Accorsi, ci racconta aneddoti e curiosità sul set del thriller diretto da Stefano Mordini.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.desc: Giulia Schiavo, Simone Susinna e Antonella Carone in un melodramma crime di Francesca Schirru. Una ragazza trova il coraggio di troncare la sua relazione tossica con il pregiudicato Nunzio, sposato con una capoclan, ma l'uomo esce di prigione e decide di vendicarsi.

programme.title: Blade Runner : Director's Cut
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo venturo un investigatore ha il compito di eliminare un gruppo di androidi assassini in fuga dal loro artefice, ma nel corso della propria ricerca viene a conoscenza di una verità terrificante.

programme.title: Il Capitale Umano - Human Capital
programme.desc: Marisa Tomei, Liev Schreiber e Peter Sarsgaard nell’adattamento del romanzo di Stephen Amidon. La relazione fra i rispettivi figli adolescenti spinge la vita di due famiglie in una spirale di rapporti ambigui e torbidi affari. Una svolta inaspettata stravolgerà gli equilibri.

programme.title: Diamanti
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek firma il suo maggior successo con un maestoso cast al femminile. Un regista convoca le sue attrici preferite: vuole fare un film sulle donne ma non svela altro.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.desc: Francesco Bruni dirige Kim Rossi Stuart in un racconto autobiografico sul tema della fragilita'. La diagnosi di una malattia costringe un regista a rivalutare i suoi legami personali.

programme.desc: Miglior sceneggiatura a Berlino 2019 per il film di Claudio Giovannesi tratto dal bestseller di Roberto Saviano. Napoli: l'ascesa di un gruppo di giovanissimi nel mondo della criminalita'.

programme.desc: Toccante film soprannaturale con Robin Williams. Un uomo viaggia dal Paradiso all'Inferno per salvare la moglie suicida, condannata alla dannazione eterna. Oscar agli effetti speciali.

programme.desc: Francesco Bruni dirige Kim Rossi Stuart in un racconto autobiografico sul tema della fragilita'. La diagnosi di una malattia costringe un regista a rivalutare i suoi legami personali.

programme.title: After Yang
programme.desc: Colin Farrell nel film targato Sky Original, premiato al Sundance Festival. Nel futuro, i membri di una famiglia devono fare i conti con il malfunzionamento dell'androide che vive con loro.

programme.title: Southpaw - L'ultima sfida
programme.desc: Avvincente dramma sul mondo della boxe con Jack Gyllenhaal e Rachel McAdams. Caduto in disgrazia dopo un incidente, un pugile deve tornare sul ring per ottenere la custodia della figlia.

programme.title: Io sono ancora qui
programme.desc: Walter Salles dirige Fernanda Torres in una storia vera premiata a Venezia e con l'Oscar 2025. Brasile, 1971: un giorno, all'improvviso, Rubens Paiva viene prelevato da casa.

programme.title: Le otto montagne
programme.desc: Miglior film ai David di Donatello e Premio della giuria a Cannes per la storia di amicizia tra Pietro (Luca Marinelli) e Bruno (Alessandro Borghi) e il loro legame con la montagna.

programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Kate Winslet, vincitrice del Golden Globe, in un dramma coniugale diretto da Sam Mendes, che racconta la crisi di una coppia borghese nell'America degli anni 50.

programme.title: Un Semplice Incidente
programme.desc: In Iran un uomo incontra per caso una persona che ritiene essere stata il suo torturatore. L'uomo nega strenuamente di essere coinvolto nella faccenda, cosa che insospettisce ancora di più chi lo ha riconosciuto.

programme.title: La stanza accanto
programme.desc: Tilda Swinton e Julianne Moore in un dramma di Pedro Almodovar, Leone d'Oro a Venezia. Martha è una reporter di guerra malata di cancro che ha deciso di suicidarsi con una pillola. Ingrid, una sua amica di infanzia, passa con lei gli ultimi giorni prima del momento fatale.

programme.title: Il signore delle formiche
programme.desc: Gianni Amelio dirige Luigi Lo Cascio ed Elio Germano nella pellicola che ricostruisce la vicenda umana del caso Braibanti e il bigottismo dell'Italia degli anni 60.

programme.title: Primadonna
programme.desc: La battaglia di una donna nel primo lungometraggio di Marta Savina. Sicilia, anni 60: Lia rifiuta un matrimonio riparatore trascinando Lorenzo e i suoi complici in tribunale.

programme.title: Profeti
programme.desc: Alessio Cremonini dirige Jasmine Trinca e Isabella Nefar. Siria, 2015: prigioniera dei fondamentalisti islamici, una giornalista italiana si confronta con la devota moglie di un miliziano.

programme.title: Beautiful Minds
programme.desc: Il valore dell'amicizia in un film on the road. Due uomini, soli e molto diversi, si ritrovano a viaggiare su un carro funebre verso il sud della Francia con una nuova leggerezza nel cuore.

programme.title: Napoli velata
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek dirige Giovanna Mezzogiorno e Alessandro Borghi fra sensualita' e mistero. Napoli: la vita di un'anatomopatologa viene sconvolta dal passionale incontro con uno sconosciuto.

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...
programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: Quando
programme.desc: Neri Marcorè e Valeria Solarino in un film di Walter Veltroni. Entrato in coma ai funerali di Berlinguer nel 1984, un uomo si risveglia dopo 31 anni. Sarà per lui una nuova rinascita.

programme.title: Riunione di famiglia (Non sposate le mie figlie 3)
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo della saga multietnica con Christian Clavier. Per il 40esimo anniversario di matrimonio di Claude e Marie le figlie organizzano una festa a sorpresa.

programme.title: Compagni di scuola

Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.

Successivamente, stufo del peso del successo, decide di ritirarsi in una casa di legno nel bosco. Ma Matilde si rifa' viva molti mesi piu' tardi, con un neonato in braccio. La reazione dubbiosa di Arturo la spinge a fuggire per sposarsi con un altro uomo...

programme.title: Nfl: Denver – La Chargers
programme.desc: Hoće li domaćini predvođeni Jaleelom McLaughlinom prekinuti negativni niz? Broncosi su posljednja tri međusobna susreta izgubili, a u posljednjem su poraženi od Chargersa 20:23.

programme.title: Nogomet – Liga Prvaka: Arsenal – Sporting
programme.desc: Arsenal je svladao Sporting u prvom ogledu četvrtfinala Lige prvaka, a portugalski sastav ima težak zadatak jer će u gostima morati tražiti barem pogodak za povratak u borbu za prolaz.

programme.title: Košarka – Aba Liga: Liga: Dubai – Partizan G2
programme.desc: Branitelji naslova, KK Partizan Mozzart Bet BC finale ABA lige nisu dobro otvorili, a Dubai je u prvoj utakmici slavio rezultatom 99:93. Druga utakmica na rasporedu je 6. lipnja u 18:00, a...

programme.title: Rukomet – Ehf Europski Kup: Finale
programme.desc: EHF Eurokup treće je po jačini europsko klupsko rukometno natjecanje. 48 momčadi bori se naslov najboljeg.

programme.title: Nogomet – Francuska Liga: Lens – Marseille
programme.desc: Na stadionu Bollaert RC Lens, predvođen Florianom Thauvonom, dočekuje momčad Benjamina Pavarda.

programme.title: Nogomet – Premier League: Tottenham – Arsenal
programme.desc: Arsenal, lider Premier League, gostuje kod Tottenhama, koji stagnira u sredini ljestvice. Nakon 4-1 u prvom susretu uz hat-trick Eberechija Ezea, Gunners traže potvrdu nadmoć u Londonu.

programme.title: Nogomet – Talijanska Liga: Milan – Lazio
programme.desc: Ove sezone Milan ne razočarava u utakmicama visokog ranga.

programme.title: Nogomet – Španjolska Liga: Osasuna – Barcelona
programme.desc: Osasuna još uvijek vjeruje u priliku u Europi, ali za to bi trebali ukrasti tri boda uvjerljivo vodećoj Barceloni u 34. kolu LaLige.

programme.title: Nogomet – Rumunjska Liga: Rapid B. – Sepsi
programme.desc: FC Rapid București i Sepsi OSK odmjerit će snage u prvom kolu nove sezone Rumunjske lige. Susret je na rasporedu 20. srpnja 2026. u 20:30, a momčadi će se sastati na travnjaku Stadiona Rapid-Giulesti.

programme.title: Atletika: Dijamantna Liga – London
programme.desc: Jedan od najiščekivanijih atletskih događaja godine ponovno stiže u britansku prijestolnicu.

programme.title: Košarka (ž) U17 Sp: Utakmica Za 3. Mjesto
programme.desc: Oči košarkaškog svijeta će od 11. do 19. srpnja biti uprte u Brno, jer se tamo održava FIBA U17 Women's Basketball World Cup 2026. Najtalentiranije mlade košarkašice iz cijeloga svijeta okupit će...

programme.title: Nogomet – Copa Sudamericana: Nacional – Tigre
programme.desc: Nacional i Tigre otvorit će nokaut fazu Copa Sudamericane prvom međusobnom utakmicom play-offa.

programme.title: Mi Živimo Za Nogomet

programme.desc: Universidad Central i Santos odmjerit će snage u prvoj međusobnoj utakmici play-offa Copa Sudamericane.

programme.title: Sport Bez Granica

programme.title: Nogomet – Liga Prvaka: Liverpool – Psg

programme.title: Košarka – Aba Liga: Liga: Dubai – Partizan G3

programme.title: Rukomet – Lp (ž): Finale
